data.body: Fresh execution review BLOCK remediated in plan material. The plan now names the exact happy-path, held-out, integration, adopt, collection-order, and corpus oracles; defines mutation delta as the per-local-id inequality count of the complete fields/conflicts/dropped outcome; specifies separate-process pre-A3 loading and exact commands; enumerates all three assignee identities; and gives contrast-based rollback attribution, Gerrit gates, stop conditions, and re-enable evidence. No production scope changed.
